description: Bind a saved login that has no organization yet to one workspace, so later calls act inside it. A login already in another organization keeps it (profile_organization_fixed): add a login for the other workspace as the same user with OHMYHOST_ENVIRONMENT=production ohmyhost login --organization ULID --user USER_ID --json. Read organization_list first, then github_status for the selected workspace and github_connect if needed; the identifier is the platform ULID, not the provider identifier. An OHMYHOST_TOKEN process cannot select anything and needs OHMYHOST_ENVIRONMENT=production ohmyhost login --json instead.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: organization_use
